topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints significantly impact payload power allocation, necessitating a trade-off between immediate and time-tagged services. Predictive analytics, machine learning, and real-time processing optimize resource utilization by forecasting storage needs, adapting to changing conditions, and enabling dynamic prioritization.
reference_context: SatCom systems face challenges in managing on-board storage, necessitating efficient allocation strategies to ensure QoS.
